items.title: ENA unlock: 93,750,000 ENA (0.625% of supply) · Core contributors (30% of supply) + amount not published · Investors
items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
headlines.summary: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

headlines.title: CFTC Staff Clarifies Crypto Use in Operating Reserves
headlines.summary: Staff guidance points to valuation discounts of at least 20% for bitcoin and ether and 2% for qualifying payment stablecoins. These assets cannot meet the operating-resource liquidity minimum.

headlines.title: FinCEN Flags $14.7 Billion in Potential Iran Shadow Banking
headlines.summary: The analysis highlights front companies and cross-border bank transfers, but does not quantify a crypto or stablecoin share of the potentially Iran-linked activity.

headlines.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
headlines.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

headlines.title: BTCS Sells 27,300 ETH to Repay $43.8M in Aave Debt
headlines.summary: About $10.5 million of Aave borrowing remains, alongside $17.9 million in convertible notes due in 2027.

headlines.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
headlines.summary: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

headlines.title: Perps and Swaps: How to Trade the News on Decrypt
headlines.summary: Decrypt readers can now swap tokens and trade perpetual futures from a single Money Account. Here's how The Information Exchange works.

headlines.title: Du Jun Eyes Purchase of Rune's Entire SKY Holding
headlines.summary: Christensen says he still owes about 77 million USDS and is exploring direct SKY sales to repay it. stUSDS withdrawals remain unavailable.

headlines.title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
headlines.summary: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.

headlines.title: Sky cofounder weighs SKY sale to repay $77 million as stUSDS pool runs dry
headlines.summary: USDS held near $1 on Monday even as the separate stUSDS lending pool had no funds available for withdrawals.

headlines.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
headlines.summary: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

headlines.title: DeFi Development extends Solana buying streak to 11 straight weeks, SOL treasury hits 2.62 million
headlines.summary: DeFi Development added about 5,180 SOL, lifting its Solana treasury to 2.62 million SOL in its 11th straight week of buying since Sept. 14.

headlines.title: Rune Says He Repaid 3M USDS as stUSDS Squeeze Persists
headlines.summary: The Sky co-founder said he still owes about 77 million USDS and is exploring direct SKY sales to institutions. The pool continued to display no withdrawal liquidity.

headlines.title: OKXICE launches tokenized securities venue with 113 assets confirmed for 24/7 trading
headlines.summary: The current lineup of issuers and asset managers includes eToro, Fidelity, Strive, BitGo, Circle, Coinbase, Robinhood, and Strategy.

headlines.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
headlines.summary: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.

headlines.title: Vstock Selects Metagood to Power Issuer-Sponsored Tokenization for Its 1,000+ Issuers
headlines.summary: SEC-registered transfer agent Vstock Transfer has selected Metagood’s platform to offer issuer-sponsored tokenized shares to its more than 1,000 issuers, with token and book-entry holders on one register.

headlines.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
headlines.summary: The Intercontinental Exchange-backed venture said it has confirmed 113 assets for listing as trading begins, following a wave of objections from companies initially picked for inclusion.

headlines.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
headlines.summary: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.

headlines.title: Sky’s stUSDS Rates Near 50% as Withdrawal Squeeze Persists
headlines.summary: The lending pool still shows full utilization and no available liquidity, while a holder asks governance for a withdrawal plan and fair access to repayments.

headlines.title: OCBC Pilots Stablecoin-to-Fiat Business Payments
headlines.summary: NTT DOCOMO Asia is the first customer in the StraitsX trial, which lets recipients receive fiat funds in their existing OCBC accounts.

headlines.title: South Korea to publish draft of comprehensive crypto legal framework this week
headlines.summary: The draft is expected to include a licensing regime for crypto businesses and a bank-centered issuance system for local stablecoins.

headlines.title: Singapore’s OCBC, StraitsX launch pilot for cross-border business stablecoin payments
headlines.summary: The setup uses StraitsX's infrastructure for onchain collection and compliance, while OCBC handles the fiat off-ramp.

headlines.title: Maple's SyrupUSDC Loans are Fully Covered, Bitquery Says (Source Correct)
headlines.summary: An Ethereum wallet held the 400 bitcoin that Bitquery’s first count missed. Maple later added the wallet to its public list.

headlines.title: MUFG Details Canton Test for Intraday JGB Repo Funding
headlines.summary: The bank-led experiment would preserve bonds’ existing legal status while exploring digital deposits, stablecoins and longer settlement windows.

headlines.title: Aave Raises Ethereum USDC Borrow Cap to $4 Billion
headlines.summary: If supply stayed at Nov. 21 levels, filling the new cap would leave about 170 million USDC unborrowed, versus roughly 1.06 billion in the snapshot.

headlines.title: How Crypto-Backed Loans Work: Collateral to Repayment
headlines.summary: Aave’s public rules show how pledged crypto backs a separate debt, why that debt grows and what repayment frees up.

headlines.title: BTCS Warns of Liquidation Risk on $54M Aave Debt
headlines.summary: The Nasdaq-listed company reported about $10 million less debt over ten days, but its ETH-backed borrowing remains exposed to liquidation.

headlines.title: ECB Seeks Partners for Appia Tokenized Finance Tests
headlines.summary: Applications for the first exercises are due Dec. 11, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis. The call includes deposit-settlement tests using mock central bank money.

headlines.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
headlines.summary: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

headlines.title: Aave Voters Back Plan to Narrow V3 Core Collateral
headlines.summary: Existing loans would stay open as LlamaRisk’s plan steers borrowers toward retained collateral or Aave V4.
